English.Text:
Implementation of the Civic Surveillance System

In response to rising crime and various forms of antisocial behavior,
the General Staff has authorized the implementation of the Civic Surveillance System.
Designed to preserve the freedom, order, and security of the population, this program will allow for the observation, recording, and correction of social deviations before they disrupt collective stability.
Constant monitoring will ensure that every citizen continues to contribute to the common good.

The General Staff

The Emergence of a New Technical Class

In response to the growing demands for administrative efficiency and scientific management, a new class of specialists has begun to take shape: the technocrats.
Trained in technical disciplines and advanced planning systems, these professionals will assume key responsibilities in organizing production, overseeing critical infrastructure, and optimizing public services.
Authorities expect their rational and methodical approach to contribute to a more orderly, stable, and predictable society.
Various state agencies have already begun adapting their structures to fully integrate these new managers of progress.
